claims.text: Current guideline: the 2026 ACC/AHA multisociety Guideline on the Management of Dyslipidemia, which replaces the 2018 blood cholesterol guideline.
claims.quote: The "2026 ACC/AHA/AACVPR/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Dyslipidemia" retires and replaces the "2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol."

claims.text: Scope: evaluating, managing and monitoring dyslipidemias, including high blood cholesterol, hypertriglyceridemia and elevated lipoprotein(a).
claims.quote: The focus of this clinical practice guideline is to address the evaluation, management, and monitoring of individuals with dyslipidemias, including high blood cholesterol, hypertriglyceridemia, and elevated lipoprotein(a).
